verified_against_live_ui.notes: NOT RUN. Engine identified from the homepage HTML only (theme sets predictive_search_url '/search/suggest'; search form action '/search'; Shopify native search). Both paths are disallowed for all user-agents by https://biggreenegg.com/robots.txt ('Disallow: /search'). Framework L14 requires robots to be respected, and the handoff forbids bot-protection bypass, so no request was made to /search or /search/suggest and the live-UI control gate could not be passed. -1 values mean 'not measured'. Capture (stage 4) is therefore not started.

limitations: robots.txt Disallow: /search blocks both the predictive endpoint (/search/suggest) and the results page (/search?q=) the shopper's search box uses; no search request was issued.

Unblocking needs either written permission from the site owner (or a robots exception), or an owner-run/owner-supplied export of the search results; the engine path above is the proposed profile, untested.
Predictive vs full results page: the theme exposes both; the live-UI control gate must check which one the box shows (dropdown) before capture.
